decisions.title: The dispatch table is tracked data, validated fail-closed
decisions.rationale: Three consumers (loop compose, spawnreg grants, nav hints) need one truth; tracked JSON with launcher-style fail-closed shape checks; bounds live in runner code.

decisions.title: Two worker forms: script workers never run an LLM, never run repo code in-process
decisions.rationale: Class S fixed-argv sandboxed spawns; Class P pinned-worktree legs; execution-integrity pin closes the post-BUILD module-load window.

decisions.title: BUILD wave dispatch under the three contracts
decisions.rationale: Runner-side iterator over the frozen snapshot; input prompt pointers only; process deny/frozen checks; output one commit within declared files; wave-unit breaker labels.

decisions.title: Trust semantics split into three named tiers
decisions.rationale: Mechanical clearance (stamp pairing), progress release (per-stage release check), human approval (never delegated); ratify writes cleared with legacy tolerance.

decisions.title: Spawn telemetry: model pin, command counts, dual-window capture
decisions.rationale: Runner-enforced model argv; advisory self-report fields never classify; head 256KB + tail 1MB sidecars under the store; windows pruned with stamps.

decisions.title: Per-stage capability floors and verb grants
decisions.rationale: Dispatch-declared profiles and grants; store-side authoritative registry with ro-bound manifests and request/ack admission; caps bounded by the hard ceiling.

decisions.title: Nav hints consume the dispatch table and the auto store
decisions.rationale: Task facade keeps the layer graph legal; read-only store reads; hint names artifact, advance verb, human-gate refusal in marker sessions.

decisions.title: One shared substrate: constants home, single spawn runner, store mutex
decisions.rationale: SPAWN_MAX_BUFFER/DEFAULT_LIMITS/DEFAULT_WALL_SEC defined once; idle killer inherited by redteam by construction; mutate serialized fail-closed.
